question: What is the ore of aluminium called?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bauxite**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bauxite** is the principal ore of aluminium.
 
• It is primarily composed of minerals such as gibbsite, boehmite, and diaspore.
 
• Bauxite is found in various regions around the world, including Australia, China, and Brazil.
 
• The extraction of aluminium from bauxite involves a process called the Bayer process.
 
• Bauxite is also used in the production of refractory materials, abrasives, and chemicals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Malachite** is an ore of copper.
 
• **Magnetite** and **Haematite** are ores of iron.
 
• Aluminium is the most abundant metal in the Earth's crust and is widely used in various industries due to its properties such as low density, high strength, and resistance to corrosion.
 
• The discovery of bauxite dates back to 1821, when it was first identified in Les Baux, France.
 
• Recycling aluminium is energy-efficient and significantly reduces the environmental impact compared to extracting it from bauxite.
